title: Matter
content: Matter is made up of tiny particles, and has mass and takes up space[cite: 1].

title: Brownian Motion
content: Brownian motion is the continuous random movement of small particles suspended in a gas or liquid, which arises from collisions with the gas or liquid particles[cite: 1].

title: Element
content: An element is a substance that cannot be broken down into other simpler substances through chemical means[cite: 1].

title: Compound
content: A compound is a substance containing two or more different elements chemically joined together in a fixed ratio[cite: 1].

title: Sublimation
content: Sublimation is the change of solid state directly into gaseous state without melting[cite: 1].

title: Solution
content: A solution is a clear homogeneous mixture obtained when a substance dissolves in a solvent, in which the solute is uniformly distributed throughout[cite: 1].
